decision.reasoning_trace: After filtering out numerous accessories like cases, cables, and shelves that were mixed into the feed, I focused on dedicated Bluetooth speakers with high ratings and strong review sentiment. The JBL Clip 3 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_147) was the clear standout due to its 4.7 rating and massive review volume, indicating consistent quality and durability. I also seriously considered the EDUPLINK (prod_bluetooth_speakers_051) for its 20W power and high rating at a budget price, and the JBL Pulse 4 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_131) as a premium light-show option. Ultimately, the portability and proven performance of the JBL Clip 3 made it the most logical purchase for a general-use portable speaker.
